items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Red (P) (O) (Batiste)... take me out one night to hear Tony Jackson. Boy I was so proud and he played such beautiful piano you know.

ctx.x: Just wanted to see Chicago. Left, Clinton, Illinois, that's where I walked off. Because we were going to work on the railroad. But I wanted to hear Tony Jackson.
Yes but I mean how did you come to leave New Orleans?
